summary: Updated implementation plan incorporating complete Role-Based UI Separation (RBAC) across 5 distinct operational workspaces: 1) Gérant / Direction, 2) Réceptionnaire / Service Advisor, 3) Chef d'Atelier & Mécanicien, 4) Magasinier / Pièces de Rechange, and 5) Caisse & Facturation. Details role-adaptive sidebar navigation, TopBar role switcher with PIN security, role-specific screen layouts, permission matrices, and failure modes.
